mapper.sql: t.id, t.session_id, t.sitting_no, t.sitting_name, t.total_duration_sec, t.remaining_sec, t.status, t.current_section_no, t.objective_score, t.started_at, t.finished_at
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO exam_session_sitting (session_id, sitting_no, sitting_name, total_duration_sec, remaining_sec, status, current_section_no, objective_score, started_at, finished_at) VALUES
(#{r.sessionId}, #{r.sittingNo}, #{r.sittingName}, #{r.totalDurationSec}, #{r.remainingSec}, #{r.status}, #{r.currentSectionNo}, #{r.objectiveScore}, #{r.startedAt}, #{r.finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_session_sitting t WHERE t.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY t.sitting_no
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_session_sitting SET status = 'FINISHED', remaining_sec = 0, objective_score = #{objectiveScore}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'FINISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_session_sitting t JOIN exam_session s ON s.id = t.session_id WHERE t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND s.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND t.started_at IS NOT NULL AND t.started_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL (t.total_duration_sec + 60) SECOND) ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM exam_session_sitting t JOIN exam_session s ON s.id = t.session_id WHERE s.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND t.status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_session_sitting prev WHERE prev.session_id = t.session_id AND prev.sitting_no = t.sitting_no - 1 AND prev.status = 'FINISHED' AND prev.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND prev.finished_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ) ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}
